verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents first-party AI-agent primitives that give agent steps durability. These are durable multi-turn chat agents (one task per conversation surviving deploys and crashes) and a tool() definition where needsApproval pauses the run while it stays alive. It also forwards streams from any AI provider. However, the evidence never names specific wrapped AI SDKs, agent frameworks, or model-provider integrations, so the 'wraps my AI stack without glue code' breadth is only implied. Missing for 10: named first-party integrations with specific AI SDKs/agent frameworks (e.g. documented adapters), documented per-provider model integrations, independent or hands-on corroboration of durability for wrapped agent steps.

support.subject: As an agent builder, first-party integrations wrap my AI stack — AI SDKs, agent frameworks, model providers — so agent steps get durability without glue code

citations.quote: Durable multi-turn AI chats — one Trigger.dev task per conversation, surviving refreshes, deploys, and crashes.
